entities.summary: Francesco Venier was a political leaders in Venice (1489, Venice – 1556-06-02), recognized as a landmark figure in the Medieval era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
